name: @pipeworx/mcp-dogceo

tools.name: random_image
tools.description: Get a random dog photo. Returns image URL and breed name. Use when you need any dog picture without a specific breed preference.

tools.name: list_breeds
tools.description: List all available dog breeds and sub-breeds. Returns breed names and varieties. Use to explore breeds or validate a breed name before fetching images.

tools.name: breed_images
tools.description: Get multiple dog photos for a specific breed (e.g., 'labrador', 'poodle'). Returns array of image URLs. Use when you need a gallery of one breed.

breed.description: The breed name (e.g. "hound", "labrador"). Use list_breeds to see valid values.

count.description: Number of images to return. Defaults to 3.

tools.name: random_breed_image
tools.description: Get one dog photo for a specific breed (e.g., 'golden_retriever', 'bulldog'). Returns image URL and breed name. Use when you need exactly one photo of a particular breed.

breed.description: The breed name (e.g. "hound", "labrador"). Use list_breeds to see valid values.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-dogceo forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the dogceo pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
